description: The Czech national pollutant release and transfer register. The IRZ home page says the register has covered reporting years since 2004, that its search application shows which substances are reported in a town or region, greenhouse gas releases from heat and power plants and accidental releases, and that the ministry publishes each reporting year's data at the end of September, now for 2024. The open data page lists datasets published on the national catalogue data.gov.cz: facilities that report to IRZ taken from the Central Environmental Register, releases and transfers of substances by reporting facility for a given year (to air, water and soil, and transfers in wastewater and waste), a package of older years, and installations under integrated permits from the IPPC information system. It is free to use. Coverage is Czechia at facility level. Caveats: the page says open data for 2024 will follow the search application, and the licence and formats are not stated on the pages read. For simulation it locates industrial facilities and their releases and permits, for exposure mapping and consequence modelling. A related catalogue record is the EU Industrial Emissions Portal.
